desc: 附折叠勺的儿童午餐保温罐，晴空蓝色块配留白信息图
leaf: 儿童保温食物罐（附折叠勺）
name: 儿童午餐保温食物罐款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼抓住点击，交出一张干净合规的直立主图
一秒讲清随身带饭的核心利益，两枚空徽章位承接主张而不写死数值
用操场午餐场景让家长代入自家孩子带饭的一天
正上方微距证明口径大、装得下看得见，顺手承接三条空白特性位
用无数字尺寸括号与四条空条目消除结构与大小疑虑
同家族器型并列，让买家按器型与配色完成选款
以价值观留白排版与真实小手抱罐收口，降低家长决策风险

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, flat sky-blue #6CC1E8 colour blocks for benefit and infographic screens, warm off-white #F7F3EC ledges and real stone or concrete surfaces for lifestyle scenes, always with one diagonal hatch stripe motif on an outer edge
style.iconSystem: thin-line single-colour pictograms inside plain circular discs, uniform stroke weight, no gradients, no filled 3d badges
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light, front-left key with bounce fill, gentle contact shadows; scenes lit by overcast or window daylight around 5200-6000K with a single consistent light direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean bright kid-tableware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm off-white #F7F3EC, one sky-blue accent block #6CC1E8 and charcoal text #2E3440; neutral high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadows, lifestyle screens lit by soft 5200-6000K daylight from one direction; modern geometric sans-serif used only as blank layout scaffolding with headline and label positions left empty; thin-line single-colour icons inside plain circular discs; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements such as blank callout lines, empty badge discs and unnumbered dimension brackets; stable upright product angle and constant product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no rendered brand marks or legible invented copy
style.presentationRules: upright vessel kept at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle with constant scale across the set; lid and folding spoon may be shown detached or nested but never covering the body; product never clipped by the frame
style.surfaceSystem: matte white counter #FFFFFF, warm grey stone paving #C8C0B4, warm matte concrete wall #DAD3C6
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif scaffolding only; rendered in-image copy is stripped, headline and label positions stay as blank rule lines
